resources.title: The ULTIMATE Beginners Guide For VALORANT 2026!
resources.creator: Rem
resources.noteEs: El video que mandás a alguien que recién instaló Valorant. Cubre fundamentals — economía, agent select, callouts, mecánica de tiro — sin filler ni hype. 8 minutos para arrancar.
resources.noteEn: The video to send someone who just installed Valorant. Covers fundamentals — economy, agent select, callouts, shooting mechanics — without filler or hype. 8 minutes to get started.

resources.title: The ULTIMATE Movement Guide for VALORANT 2026!
resources.creator: Rem
resources.noteEs: Movement en Valorant es no-trivial — counter-strafing, jiggle peeking, jump-peeks. Rem cubre lo básico estructurado para que players nuevos no peguen mal por moverse mal antes de disparar.
resources.noteEn: Movement in Valorant is non-trivial — counter-strafing, jiggle peeking, jump-peeks. Rem structures the basics so new players don't whiff because they moved wrong before shooting.

resources.title: You're Losing Gunfights in Valorant (Here's Why)
resources.creator: StratoZen
resources.noteEs: Diagnóstico para players que pierden duelos sin entender por qué. StratoZen identifica 5 errores comunes (peek timing, crosshair placement, sound) y explica el fix en cada uno. Útil cuando el ranked se siente injusto.
resources.noteEn: Diagnostic for players who lose duels without understanding why. StratoZen identifies 5 common errors (peek timing, crosshair placement, sound) and explains the fix for each. Useful when ranked feels unfair.

resources.noteEn: For returning players: how the current act's rank reset works, what placements to expect, and how to avoid losing MMR by playing the first placement matches poorly.

resources.title: The Valorant Ranked Reset is BRUTAL...

resources.noteEs: Segunda perspectiva del rank reset, con foco más editorial sobre por qué Riot lo cambió y qué significa para players de cada elo. Complementa al video de Kaemi con análisis del por qué.
